description: Flights and Passengers from London Airports is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Greater London Authority. UK Airport Statistics are available each month from the Civil Aviation Authority. Table shows number of passengers handled by each London airport, and the country of destination of each passenger arriving into or departing from London's airports in the whole of 2011. Coverage: Greater London Authority. The portal files it under the publisher Greater London Authority. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLS. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
